pattern: put up to {n:Qty} of {g:Seen} on top of your library and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order
subject: none

examples.text: Look at the top four cards of your library. Put up to two of them on top of your library and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
Reveal the top five cards of your library. Put up to one of them on top of your library and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

counterExamples: Look at the top four cards of your library. Put up to two of them on top of your library and the rest into your graveyard.

pattern: shuffle your library , then exile the top card
subject: none

examples.text: Shuffle your library, then exile the top card. Until end of turn, you may play that card without paying its mana cost.
Shuffle your library, then exile the top card. You may play that card this turn.

counterExamples: Shuffle your graveyard, then exile the top card.
Shuffle your library, then exile the top two cards.
Shuffle your library, then exile the bottom card.

pattern: put a card from among {g:Milled} into your hand
subject: none

examples.text: Mill four cards. Put a card from among the milled cards into your hand.
Mill three cards. Put a card from among them into your hand. Draw a card.

counterExamples: Mill four cards. Put a land card from among the milled cards into your hand.
Mill four cards. Put a card from among the milled cards onto the battlefield.
Look at the top four cards of your library. Put a card from among them into your hand.
Mill four cards. Put two cards from among the milled cards into your hand.

Reveal the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand, put one of them on the bottom of your library, and exile one of them.
